hardware_info.WAN: 1x RJ46, VDSL1/2 and ADSL1/2/2+ capable (via VRX208), Fast Ethernet capable (via [[http://www.icplus.com.tw/pp-IP101A.html|IC+ IP101A LF]])

openwrt_ticket_20409.titel: uboot-lantiq: Arcadyan VGV7510KW22 brn-boot V1.08.01 does not work
openwrt_ticket_20409.beschreibung: devices with brn-boot V1.08.01 cannot be flashed in any way; tests were done on 2 devices; An older O2-Box with brn-boot V1.07 works like described in wiki.
openwrt_ticket_20409.kommentar_soc: Your (and my) device has a Lantiq VRX288 v1.2 chipset, which requires a few modifications. Older devices have an Lantiq VRX288 v1.1 chipset.
openwrt_ticket_20409.kommentar_phy: "SoC: Lantiq VRX288 v1.2" This is the reason why u-boot can't talk to the ethernet PHYs (because the PHY firmware that is used is only compatible with SoC revision v1.1).
openwrt_ticket_20409.kommentar_ip101a: Phy not found message related to a IC+ IP101A, which is soldered on the board but only connected to the CPU.
openwrt_ticket_20409.bootlog_v12: Wireless VDSL Gateway VR9 Loader V1.08.02 build Mar 12 2014 14:36:06, Arcadyan Technology Corporation, MXIC MX29GL128EL top boot 16-bit mode found
openwrt_ticket_20409.uboot_v12: U-Boot 2014.01-openwrt4 ... Board: Arcadyan VGV7510KW22, SoC: Lantiq VRX288 v1.2, CPU: 500 MHz, IO: 250 MHz, BUS: 250 MHz, BOOT: NOR, DRAM: 64 MiB, Flash: 16 MiB
